title: Friedrich Ebert Foundation: Scholarship for International Students
summary: Study support for international students at German universities who combine strong academic results with social and political engagement.

degree_levels.notes: Includes Bachelor's, Master's, Diplom and state-examination courses.

subject_areas.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: The FAQ names regional target groups and excludes examples including USA, Australia, New Zealand and Japan. Its EU wording varies between answers. This is not a complete country whitelist; confirm the relevant FES route.

residence.notes: The programme page says applications from abroad are formally possible; the linked FAQ says applicants must already be in Germany. Confirm the applicable stage and route with FES.

mandatory.text: Study at a German state or state-recognised university or university of applied sciences, with initial graded academic results.
Above-average grades, socio-political engagement and identification with social-democratic values.
German at B2 level is accepted, including for English-taught courses; the page says a certificate is not required.
For Bachelor's, Diplom and state examinations, apply after the first semester and at least three semesters before the end of the standard study period.
Medicine applicants apply after the fourth semester or Physikum and by the end of the sixth semester.
Master's applicants apply before or at the beginning of their first university semester; the page lists 30 November for winter and 31 May for summer.
The FAQ states a 15-month residence limit, with exceptions for educational/research/preparatory stays and recognised refugees; obtain route-specific confirmation.

funding.description: EUR 992 per month, health-insurance costs covered, plus EUR 255 monthly for scholarship holders with a child.
funding.duration: Study support; the precise award duration must be confirmed for the applicant's programme.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: Master's: apply before/at the beginning of the first semester, with 30 November (winter) and 31 May (summer) listed. Other degrees have different study-stage limits. These recurring dates are not a confirmed universal current round.

steps.text: Review the degree-stage and language requirements.
Use the foundation's online scholarship application.
